Resolved 0 of 2040

2040 imported documents could not be linked to a Township, Subject, and/or Donation. Fix one taxonomy document, then re-run the import — or open an image in Studio. Checking Resolved in either view updates the other.

How to fix
  1. Prefer the “By missing value” view: create or alias one Township / Subject, then re-run the import so many images link at once.
  2. Set Migration key to the exact CSV value (any casing). Add Migration Key Aliases for extra spellings. Do not put Archive IDs on township.
  3. Use “By image” when you need to open a single document in Studio (local Studio at localhost:3333).
  4. donation:0 is invalid — leave unlinked. donation:N must exist as a Donation.
  5. Mark Resolved when you have finished with that image. Export JSON to back up checkmarks.
